projects.title: E-Commerce Data Mining & BI Platform
projects.title_ar: منصة تنقيب بيانات التجارة الإلكترونية وذكاء الأعمال
projects.tagline: End-to-end transaction analysis, RFM customer segmentation, and interactive star-schema Power BI dashboard.
projects.tagline_fr: Analyse de 7000+ transactions, segmentation RFM K-Means et tableau de bord Power BI en schéma en étoile.
projects.tagline_ar: تحليل أكثر من 7000 معاملة، تقسيم العملاء باستخدام RFM و K-Means، ولائحة قيادة Power BI.
projects.description: Comprehensive data science and business intelligence project analyzing over 7,000 customer transactions. Designed a star-schema data warehouse, conducted RFM segmentation using K-Means clustering, and implemented predictive customer churn models with Random Forest and Gradient Boosting.
projects.context: Modern e-commerce enterprises generate vast amounts of transactional data. Without unified customer profiling and churn prediction, marketing teams miss retention opportunities.
projects.approach: Built an ETL pipeline in Python (Pandas/SQL), engineered RFM features, performed K-Means clustering to identify high-value buyer personas, and developed a star-schema data warehouse in MySQL with an interactive Power BI reporting suite.
projects.results: Segmented 7,000+ transactions into 4 distinct buyer profiles, yielding an estimated 18% improvement in customer retention strategy targeting.
projects.learned: Advanced relational schema modeling, cluster silhouette evaluation, and executive Power BI KPI presentation.

projects.title: Customer Churn Analysis Dashboard
projects.title_fr: Tableau de Bord d'Analyse de l'Attrition Client
projects.tagline: Statistical EDA and predictive churn modeling across 7,000+ customer records.
projects.tagline_fr: Analyse exploratoire et modèle prédictif d'attrition sur 7000+ dossiers clients.
projects.tagline_ar: تحليل استكشافي ونموذج تنبؤ بتسرب العملاء لأكثر من 7000 سجل.
projects.description: End-to-end churn risk profiling system built using Python, Pandas, Scikit-learn, and Power BI to identify key risk drivers and empower customer success teams.
projects.context: Subscription platforms lose significant revenue to customer churn. Identifying early risk indicators enables targeted retention workflows.
projects.approach: Cleaned and transformed 7,000+ customer records. Performed univariate and bivariate EDA, trained logistic regression and Random Forest models, and visualized customer churn probabilities in Power BI.
projects.results: Discovered 12 top indicators of customer attrition and created a live probability matrix for retention specialists.
projects.learned: Imbalanced dataset handling (SMOTE), feature importance extraction, and Power BI interactive drill-throughs.

projects.title: AI Video Surveillance for Smart Agriculture
projects.title_fr: Surveillance Vidéo par IA pour l'Agriculture Intelligente
projects.title_ar: نظام المراقبة بفيديو الذكاء الاصطناعي للزراعة الذكية
projects.tagline: Real-time automated intruder detection using YOLOv8, DETR, OpenCV, and MQTT.
projects.tagline_fr: Détection d'intrusion en temps réel avec YOLOv8, DETR, OpenCV et MQTT.
projects.tagline_ar: كشف التسلل الحقيقي باستخدام YOLOv8 و DETR و OpenCV و MQTT.
projects.description: Computer vision solution for smart crop protection. Deployed YOLOv8 and DETR object detection models on video camera feeds with low-latency MQTT message broadcasting for edge notifications.
projects.context: Agricultural farmlands require automated perimeter protection against crop damage and trespassers without manual monitoring.
projects.approach: Annotated custom field dataset, fine-tuned YOLOv8 and DETR architectures in PyTorch, processed video streams with OpenCV, and published event alerts via MQTT to edge hardware.
projects.results: Achieved sub-15ms inference latency and 96.4% detection precision on outdoor agricultural video feeds.
projects.learned: Model optimization for edge deployment, PyTorch transfer learning, and real-time streaming pipelines.

projects.title: Real-Time Object Detection & Tracking Pipeline
projects.title_fr: Pipeline de Détection & Suivi d'Objets en Temps Réel
projects.title_ar: أنبوب كشف وتتبع الأجسام في الوقت الفعلي
projects.tagline: Comparative benchmark of YOLOv5, YOLOv8, and DETR on surveillance streams.
projects.tagline_fr: Benchmark comparatif de YOLOv5, YOLOv8 et DETR sur flux vidéo.
projects.tagline_ar: مقارنة معيارية بين YOLOv5 و YOLOv8 و DETR على بث الفيديو.
projects.description: Custom video processing pipeline benchmarking CNN and Transformer architectures for high-speed object detection and tracking in multi-camera setups.
projects.context: Security video analysis requires choosing the optimal trade-off between frame rate (FPS) and mean Average Precision (mAP).
projects.approach: Built modular video pipeline using Python, PyTorch, OpenCV, and TensorFlow. Conducted automated comparative performance metrics across custom datasets.
projects.results: Identified optimal deployment thresholds for 60 FPS video ingestion with zero dropped frames.
projects.learned: Deep learning model evaluation (mAP@0.5, mAP@0.5:0.95), CUDA acceleration, and frame buffer management.

Implemented CI/CD deployment workflows and collaborated across cross-functional teams.
Specializing in Software Architecture, Advanced Algorithmics & Systems Development.
